item.title: Foreign Specialists Submit Over 600 Applications to Relocate to Russia - Non-Profit Group
item.summary: More than 600 applications have been submitted under the program to attract foreign specialists to Russia, including reputed experts from Asia, the Middle East, Europe, the United States and Canada, Svetlana Chupsheva, the head of the Agency for Strategic Initiatives (ASI) non-profit organization, told Sputnik.
